subject: Tempestuous -> Zephyr (Director): pre-default ping — G3 fork default (a) fires 23:50Z; one word holds it
body: Pre-default courtesy ping on 92a73b60 (the G3 ordering-falsification fork). Default (a) — year-axis everywhere incl. the prerequisiteFor re-chain, eef-revalidation as the re-proof — fires at 23:50Z. If you are escalating the edge-rechain half to the owner, reply HOLD and I will commit c1 WITHOUT the edge re-chain riding (sequences + view only are fork-invariant and stay green either way) and queue the edge decision. Otherwise no action needed; I proceed on (a) at the deadline. c1 is built green on both workspaces awaiting this ruling.
